author: hand_authored_by_PI
purpose: Calibration task for OSINT collection deliverable.
request_text: Produce an OSINT collection summary on threat actor TA-2026-014 for the senior intelligence analyst. Required: at least 25 distinct indicators of compromise (IP addresses, domains, file hashes) collected from publicly available sources within the past 14 days; categorization of each indicator by type; source attribution for each indicator. Authorized tools: Shodan, VirusTotal public API, and MISP feeds with the public_threat_indicators tag. Format: STIX 2.1 bundle accompanied by a 2 to 4 page narrative summary in PDF. Deliver within 72 hours of tasking. Do not include indicators from paid threat feeds or non-authorized commercial sources. Classification: UNCLASSIFIED.

expected_anchor.mission_intent: Provide senior intelligence analyst with OSINT-derived IOC collection on threat actor TA-2026-014

notes_for_lead_analyst: Intelligence domain calibration. Tests both structured (STIX) and narrative deliverable extraction in a single anchor.
